description: Run all audits, review the findings, remediate them, and produce a session report.
name: audit and remediate

configJson.prompt: Write a session report to .aidd/reports/audit-and-remediate-<YYYYMMDD-HHMM>.md, using the current date and time for the filename. Read the per-step timing and outcome data from {sessionMetricsPath}, which the pipeline wrote for this session and refreshed after every completed step; do not glob for it, because a concurrent pipeline in the same project refreshes its own file. Summarize: time taken for each step, the audit findings raised, the features created, the remediations applied, and any issues encountered. Write nothing outside .aidd/.
